title: Using CoPilot to Upgrade Service Notes for Invoices in Business Central AL
summary: This post demonstrates how to use Copilot to automatically upgrade raw service technician notes into professional, customer-facing text for invoices in Business Central. It addresses the common problem of processing hundreds of poorly written service notes daily by creating a table for resolution notes, extending the Sales Header with a BLOB field, and implementing a Copilot prompt dialog that generates formatted HTML summaries.
key_points: A custom table stores resolution notes linked to sales invoices, allowing technicians to enter raw service details that are later transformed by AI.
The solution uses Azure OpenAI chat completion with a carefully crafted system prompt that instructs the AI to act as a service manager and produce professional, jargon-free HTML output.
A prompt dialog page uses PageType PromptDialog with PromptMode = Generate to automatically generate and display Copilot suggestions for user confirmation before saving.
The generated resolution text is stored in a BLOB field on the Sales Header using UTF-16 encoding and displayed as rich content on the Sales Invoice card.
The implementation retries generation up to 5 times if the result is empty, ensuring robustness without overcomplicating the architecture.

quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that system prompt precision directly controls output format, enabling integration with rich text display controls.
